metadata.title: fix: Intermittent logger failure in test_passthrough_headers
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

Fixed intermittent test failure in `test_passthrough_headers.py` where caplog was not consistently capturing debug messages. The issue was that `caplog.at_level()` needs an explicit logger name when multiple loggers are active during test execution.

**Key Changes:**
- Specify logger name in `caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG, logger="mcpgateway.utils.passthrough_headers")` 
- Add explicit type annotations for test dictionaries to improve type safety
- Add type ignore comment for intentional None parameter test

## Test Plan

- [x] Run full test suite: `make test`
- [x] Run test file multiple times to verify stability
- [x] Verify all quality checks pass: `make flake8 bandit interrogate pylint verify`
- [ ] Review test coverage report
- [ ] Verify no regression in other test files

Closes #[issue number if applicable]
